name: checker
description: External checker for jamuin-monitor — Node/GitHub Actions version. The scheduled cron now runs as the Supabase Edge Function in supabase/functions/checker instead (see its header comment); this copy is kept for local testing and as a manual GitHub Actions fallback (.github/workflows/check.yml). Curls each registered VPS/service over the public internet (never any monitored VPS itself), writes results to Supabase, and pushes an Expo notification on any up↔down transition. Keep in sync with supabase/functions/checker/index.ts if the check logic changes.
